description: Trains the NLU model for a Cognigy.AI flow. MUTATING: This triggers model training. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. Training is async - this tool polls until completion or timeout.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without training. Set to false to actually train.

flowId.description: The flow ID to train intents for

localeId.description: Specific locale to train. If omitted, trains all locales.

mode.description: Training mode: 'full' for complete retraining, 'quick' for incremental updates

pollIntervalMs.description: How often to check task status (1-10 seconds, default 2)

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for training to complete (5-300 seconds, default 60)

name: train_intents
